title: Phases of Muon: When Muon Eclipses SignSGD
abstract: arXiv:2605.09552v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Muon and related spectral optimizers have recently demonstrated strong empirical performance as scalable stochastic methods, often outperforming Adam. Yet their behavior remains poorly understood. We analyze stochastic Muon, which orthogonalizes an exponential moving average of minibatch gradients, on a high-dimensional matrix-valued least squares problem, and we compare it with stochastic SignSGD, a simple baseline comparable to Adam. We derive explicit deterministic dynamics that provide a tractable framework for studying learning behavior. We show that Muon has non-linear sensitivity to the effective batch $B_{\rm eff}=B(1+\beta)/(1-\beta)$. translated_abstract: Muon及相关的谱优化器（spectral optimizers）近年来作为可扩展的随机优化方法展现出强大的实证性能，常常优于Adam，然而其行为仍缺乏充分理解。我们在高维矩阵值最小二乘问题上分析了随机Muon——它对小批量梯度的指数移动平均进行正交化——并将其与随机SignSGD（一个可与Adam相媲美的简单基线）进行比较。我们推导出显式的确定性动力学，为研究学习行为提供了一个易于处理的框架。我们证明，Muon对有效批次大小 $B_{\rm eff}=B(1+\beta)/(1-\beta)$ 具有非线性敏感性：在精确白化且 $B_{\rm eff}$ 较小时，Muon无法分辨较小的特征模态，从而使收敛变慢；动量和有限的Newton–Schulz迭代可起到类似岭（ridge）的作用，减轻这一效应。这种行为与SignSGD形成对比，后者不存在这种转变，因而导致不同的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文推导了随机Muon在高维矩阵最小二乘问题上的显式确定性动力学，发现Muon对有效批次大小存在非线性敏感性——在精确白化且有效批次较小时，Muon难以分辨较小的特征模态而收敛变慢（动量与有限Newton–Schulz迭代可缓解此效应），而SignSGD并无此相变，从而阐明了Muon超越SignSGD的条件。
en_tdlr: By deriving explicit deterministic dynamics for stochastic Muon on high-dimensional matrix least squares, this paper reveals that Muon is non-linearly sensitive to the effective batch size—failing to resolve smaller eigenmodes at small effective batch sizes under exact whitening, an effect mitigated by momentum and finite Newton–Schulz iterations—whereas SignSGD exhibits no such transition, clarifying when Muon eclipses SignSGD.
